name: Aethertek technology co., Ltd.
summary: Aethertek technology co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells precision testing equipment for the consumer and automotive electronics, and AI server testing industries in Taiwan and China. It offers RF test products comprising up-down converters, RF switches, shield boxes, and passive antennas; board level tests; microprobe products, including sockets and board-to-board POGO blocks; and antenna-in-module, and antenna test and calibration products for 5G applications.
